items.title: Billy Taylor — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He taught Hazel Scott, he taught several jazz players, male and female, who were well known, so his theories of touch tone control, which he had learned from Tobias Mantay are very much evidence today.

ctx.x: How long did you study with him?

I studied with him for several years… for about four or five years. Richard was a classical teacher. He taught European classical music but he taught people who studied other things. He taught Hazel Scott, he taught several jazz players, male and female, who were well known, so his theories of touch tone control, which he had learned from Tobias Mantay are very much evidence today.
You mentioned earlier the recording of the Mad Monk. Was this your first recording?
